snippet.title: Eazy-E - Hittin' Switchez Video Game
snippet.description: Screen recording of the PC game Hittin' Switchez, included with Eazy-E's 2002 album Impact of a Legend. For a better look at the game and much more info, check out this video from @CobySucks: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DzrmPcfpKK8
